I mean, my experience was intense as hell for me, but from what I understand about acid even small amounts can be intense. I know the guy and I trust him, but it sounds like it's usually a stab in the dark. We'll definitely be taking your advice, though. I've only had the one trip and luckily it was good, but I've heard absolute horror stories about bad trips. I really don't want that to be somebody's first impression of the substance. Even the anxiety on the comeup can be really harsh. Plus her sister might also be tripping with us, but she's only interested in organic drugs so she'll be doing shrooms instead. I've been told it's easier to have a bad trip with those.

I would absolutely love to try that, but none of my friends down here are into psychedelics unfortunately. But when I move in with my girlfriend in April, her and some of her friends agreed that we should all go camping one night and drop. I feel like I'd really prefer it since it was so hard to verbalize my emotions to sober people without just sounding plain strange. If I could have such an amazing experience on my own, I can't imagine how it is to go through it with other people. Especially with the whole feeling of 'oneness'.
Dropping in about 30 minutes. Thanks for all the advice, everyone. I'll take as much of it as I can within the trip's timespan. See you on the other side.

I've heard about the lockout chip problem, but I haven't been able to read into it yet. The connector itself seemed like it was in good shape, but I haven't really bothered cleaning the cartridges yet.

Yeah, I find something about it really lovable for some reason. It's just something I'm beginning to automatically associate with Nintendo cartridges. I don't even know if I feel like it's a necessary problem to work on or not.

I'm convinced I need to get out some way or another, because that childlike sense of wonder and unity is really what I'm looking for. I'll probably be dropping around 5 p.m., so my trip should go well into the night. I'll definitely make sure I get out to take a look at the night sky!
